mapper.sql: co.id AS id, co.code AS code, co.name AS name, co.amount AS amount, co.expected_date AS expectedDate, cod.crm_pipeline_setting_id AS pipelineId, cps.description AS pipelineName, cod.crm_opportunity_stag_id AS stageId, cos.name AS stageName, cod.probability AS probability, co.crm_opportunity_source_id AS sourceId, crm_opportunity_sources.name AS sourceName, co.customer_id AS organizationId, customers.name AS organizationName, co.responsibility_id AS responsibilityId, CONCAT(responsibility.first_name, ' ', responsibility.last_name) AS responsibilityName, co.division_id AS divisionId, customer_lead_divisions.title AS divisionName, co.customer_contact_id AS contactId, customer_contacts.contact_name AS contactName, co.quotation_id AS quotationId, quotations.quotation_code AS quotationNo, co.sales_order_id AS salesOrderId, orders.order_code AS salesOrderNo, co.description AS description, co.created AS created, CONCAT(creator.first_name, ' ', creator.last_name) AS createdBy, co.modified AS modified, CONCAT(modifier.first_name, ' ', modifier.last_name) AS modifiedBy

FROM crm_opportunities AS co LEFT JOIN crm_opportunity_details AS cod ON cod.crm_opportunity_id = co.id AND cod.is_active = 1 AND cod.is_convert = 0 LEFT JOIN crm_pipeline_settings AS cps ON cps.id = cod.crm_pipeline_setting_id LEFT JOIN crm_opportunity_stags AS cos ON cos.id = cod.crm_opportunity_stag_id LEFT JOIN crm_opportunity_sources ON crm_opportunity_sources.id = co.crm_opportunity_source_id LEFT JOIN customers ON customers.id = co.customer_id LEFT JOIN customer_contacts ON customer_contacts.id = co.customer_contact_id LEFT JOIN customer_lead_divisions ON customer_lead_divisions.id = co.division_id LEFT JOIN quotations ON quotations.id = co.quotation_id LEFT JOIN orders ON orders.id = co.sales_order_id LEFT JOIN users AS responsibility ON responsibility.id = co.responsibility_id LEFT JOIN users AS creator ON creator.id = co.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS modifier ON modifier.id = co.modified_by
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_opportunities SET name = #{opportunity.name}, amount = #{opportunity.amount}, expected_date = #{opportunity.expectedDate}, responsibility_id = #{opportunity.responsibilityId}, crm_opportunity_source_id = #{opportunity.sourceId}, division_id = #{opportunity.divisionId}, customer_contact_id = #{opportunity.customerContactId}, quotation_id = #{opportunity.quotationId}, sales_order_id = #{opportunity.salesOrderId}, description = #{opportunity.description}, customer_id = #{opportunity.customerId}, employee_id = #{opportunity.employeeId}, vendor_id = #{opportunity.vendorId}, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{opportunity.modifiedBy} WHERE id = #{opportunity.id} AND is_active = 1
UPDATE crm_opportunities SET is_active = 2, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{userId} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_active = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_opportunity_details ( crm_opportunity_id, crm_pipeline_setting_id, crm_opportunity_stag_id, probability, created, created_by, is_active, is_convert ) VALUES ( #{detail.opportunityId}, #{detail.pipelineId}, #{detail.stageId}, #{detail.probability}, NOW(), #{detail.createdBy}, #{detail.isActive}, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT type FROM crm_opportunity_sources WHERE is_active = 1 AND id = #{sourceId}
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_opportunities SET code = #{code} WHERE id = #{id}
